description: Search the Montana Code Annotated BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation -- "computing time deadline holiday", "landlord security deposit", "deliberate homicide". Covers all 54 MCA titles, including Title 25 chapter 20, the Montana Rules of Civil Procedure (Rule 6 computing time is MCA 25-20-206). Returns ranked sections with citation, heading and an opening excerpt; call mt_code_section with a result's citation for the full text. Full-text match, not semantic search. A query with no hits returns found:false. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "computing time period days holiday".

name: mt_code_search
